name.ja: LEDユニット デュアルタイプ(ホワイト_ブルー/レッド)

description.ja: デュアルタイプのLEDユニットが単品で登場！
description.en: Dual type LED unit now available as a single item!

description.ja: • 上のLEDは白色。横のLEDはスイッチを押すことで青色と赤色へ交互に変化。
description.en: • The top LED is white. The LED on the side changes alternately between blue and red by pressing the switch.

description.ja: • やわらかい光り方でプレミアム感を演出。
description.en: • Creates a premium feel with its soft glow.

description.ja: • 自動消灯モード（３分間）と、継続点灯モード（光り続ける）を搭載。
description.en: • Equipped with automatic light-off mode (3 minutes) and continuous light mode (continues to shine).

description.ja: • Figure-rise Standard ULTRAMAN SUIT ZERO -ACTION-（別売り）にも使用可能。
description.en: • Can also be used with Figure-rise Standard ULTRAMAN SUIT ZERO -ACTION- (sold separately).
